scope: Compiler-only evaluation of registered Python negative-test SQL with imported literal table fixtures
limitations: 61 accepted SQL programs require runtime evaluation; this probe does not pass their negative tests.
Three ignore_ examples are deliberately unregistered; they remain in the 281-assignment source census.
The probe uses classic incremental compilation and the default APPEND_ONLY=False SQL fixture path. It does not create pipelines or load input data.
The first run retains two stale NOT IN expectations; the source correction changes the expected comparison from equality to inequality.
Template clustering, catalog review and the spike 9 threshold decision remain separate.
